component.name: CedarApple
component.summary: Video player with torrent streaming and free music

description.p: CedarApple is a small video player built on mpv and Slint. It plays a file or any link mpv opens, and streams torrents while they download.

ul.li: Torrent streaming: only the file you watch is fetched, the rest of a season queues around it
Drag-to-seek on the exact frame, chapters, audio and subtitle tracks, resume where you left off
Free Music: search and play Creative Commons music from Jamendo and the Internet Archive, and download it with its licence
